author: Austine Opiyo
note: Hi, check on this, "Panjiva" is the platform's name (the pre-filled suggestion), not a market segment. For this SOP we need commodities, things that are actually traded. The homepage doesn't list any, but the research articles do, for example: - Polysilicon: https://panjiva.com/research/a/45745 - Aluminum: https://panjiva.com/research/b/45723 What to do: 1. Remove the "Panjiva" record. 2. Open each article and create one record per commodity, using the article link as source_url and the sentence that mentions it (word for word) as evidence. 3. Skip finished products (chips, tires, inverters, etc.).
why: Complaint clause is about the platform name not being a segment. source_url and evidence appear only inside step 2, a how-to for the replacement records.
